_notes.seasonSpeed: Time multiplier for the pet. 1 = real-time (a full season could take many hours). 6 = good for testing/short seasons. Lower it for a slow ambient stream.
_notes.twitch.enabled: false = SIM mode (type commands in the terminal). true = connect to Twitch chat.
_notes.twitch.oauth: Get from https://twitchtokengenerator.com or https://twitchapps.com/tmi (must start with 'oauth:'). Use a bot account or your channel account.
_notes.paid: These fire only when the chat message carried Bits (a cheer). Wire tips (Streamlabs/StreamElements) later by posting the same commands into chat from the tip alert.
